assets.name: Returns, Refunds & Exchanges
assets.description: Reverse-logistics workflows, refund handling, exchange logic, and policy-aware issue recovery. Ownership is intentionally split: returns-resolution owns the case-resolution model and refund-leakage/abuse accountability, while prime-operations-conversion-and-service-2 stewards the underlying returns runtime (brick retu) as system of record. The owner sets resolution policy and outcome quality; the steward operates the reverse-logistics data pipeline that produces the events.
assets.businessMeaning: Reusable domain data centered on Returns, Refunds & Exchanges.

interfaces.name: returns-refunds-exchanges api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Returns, Refunds & Exchanges.

governance.sharingPolicy: internal and approved domain consumers only

assets.accessScope: fulfillment operations, promise recovery, and seller performance workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Inbound, pick, pack, ship, carrier-scan, and exception events from the FBA network and seller-fulfilled operations.
